atoms.a: Das Bild „Akte der Menschlichkeit“ wurde 2024 von Aden Kurabi aufgenommen. Es zeigt Freiwillige, die in einem Wohltätigkeitszentrum arbeiten.
atoms.b: The picture ((++“Acts_of_Humanity” ++“Charity_Work”)) was taken in ((++2024 2004)) by Aden Kurabi. It shows ((++volunteers labourers)) working in a charity center.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Hauptteil der Bildbeschreibung, indem du die Lücken füllst.

atoms.b: In the bottom ((++left-hand right-hand)) corner of the picture there is a young woman typing on a laptop. She has long black hair and is smiling at two other female volunteers standing at a ((++table shelf)) with her. The two women are packing groceries into boxes and are also ((++smiling unhappy)). The woman on the right hand-side has ((++long,_brown short,_blonde)) hair and seems to be ((++the_same_age_as much_older_than)) the woman in the front.

The third woman ((++in_the_centre in_the_upper_right_corner)) of the picture has short hair and is wearing glasses. She seems ((++older younger)) than the others. The volunteers all wear green ((++T-shirts trousers)) with name tags. ((++In_the_background In_the_foreground)) there is a male volunteer. He is holding a ((++clipboard backpack)) and is talking to another man standing behind the short-haired women in the centre. In the background there is also a clothes rack with several ((++shirts bags)) on it.

atoms.b: As its name suggests, the picture is meant to show the ((++importance insignificance)) of crucial acts of humanity. The soft and vibrant colours of the scene evoke a ((++pleasant unpleasant)) atmosphere. This is underlined by the calm and ((++happy scary)) appearance of the volunteers. They are probably doing an inventory to have an overview of ((++the_textile_and_food_donations their_private_belongings)) which will be given to those in need. The picture conveys the feeling that charity work is a ((++fulfilling exhausting)) activity providing great benefits for society.
